name: Green Brook Electronics
old_description: Large store, huge inventory, rentals, repairs, books, records, surplus and more!
about:
Green Brook Electronics was founded in 1974 in Green Brook, New Jersey, and has operated as a supplier of electronic components and instrumentation for five decades. In 2018, the company relocated to a facility in North Plainfield, New Jersey, that is more than seven times larger than its original store, expanding its capacity for inventory and services.

The business stocks over 300,000 distinct line items across multiple warehouse locations, ranging from semiconductors, relays, capacitors, and resistors to wire, cable, fuses, and audio/video cables. Beyond distribution, Green Brook Electronics operates a retail store open to the public, a rental center for test equipment, a repair center capable of board-level and surface-mount work on items such as medical devices and tube amplifiers, a movie prop center offering vintage test equipment and computers for film productions, a technology studio providing soldering and Arduino lessons, a vinyl record shop, and a component identification service called Component Eye-D.

Customers include large technology firms, industrial buyers, hobbyists, film production companies, and students seeking hands-on electronics training. The company ships worldwide and emphasizes its ability to source obsolete or long-lead-time parts.

Green Brook Electronics positions itself as a solution provider rather than a simple distributor, highlighting its repair expertise, obsolete-part sourcing, and the breadth of services — from rentals to education — under one roof.
